units.title: Positive and Negative Numbers
units.summary: You will learn about numbers less than 0 and become able to do the four arithmetic operations with positive and negative numbers.

lessons.title: Numbers with Signs
lessons.summary: Numbers less than 0, positive and negative numbers, natural numbers, and how to express quantities with opposite meanings.

lessons.title: The Number Line and Absolute Value
lessons.summary: The number line, comparing numbers with inequality signs, and absolute value.

lessons.title: Addition
lessons.summary: The sum of two numbers with the same or different signs, thinking with the number line, and the commutative and associative laws of addition.

lessons.title: Subtraction
lessons.summary: The idea of subtraction as changing the sign of the number being subtracted and adding.

lessons.title: Calculations with Addition and Subtraction Mixed Together
lessons.summary: Terms, expressions with parentheses omitted, and calculating expressions that mix addition and subtraction.

lessons.title: Multiplication
lessons.summary: The sign and absolute value of the product of two numbers, the commutative and associative laws of multiplication, and powers and exponents.

lessons.title: Division
lessons.summary: The sign and absolute value of the quotient of two numbers, reciprocals, and calculations mixing multiplication and division.

lessons.title: Calculations with Mixed Operations
lessons.summary: The order of operations, the distributive law, and how number systems relate to the four operations.

lessons.title: Prime Factorization
lessons.summary: Prime numbers and expressing natural numbers as products of primes.

lessons.title: Using Positive and Negative Numbers
lessons.summary: Using them in everyday situations, such as finding averages using differences from a standard.

units.title: Letters and Expressions
units.summary: You will learn to express quantities and relationships as expressions using letters and to calculate with linear expressions.

lessons.title: Expressions Using Letters
lessons.summary: Expressing quantities as expressions using letters.

lessons.title: How to Write Expressions
lessons.summary: The rules for writing products and quotients, and notation using powers.

lessons.title: Evaluating Expressions
lessons.summary: Substitution and the value of an expression.

lessons.title: Adding and Subtracting Linear Expressions
lessons.summary: Terms and coefficients, linear expressions, and combining like terms.

lessons.title: Linear Expressions: Multiplication and Division by Numbers
lessons.summary: Multiplying a linear expression by a number and dividing it by a number, and using the distributive law.

lessons.title: Expressing Relationships with Expressions
lessons.summary: Expressing relationships between quantities with equalities and inequalities.

units.title: Linear Equations
units.summary: You will understand the meaning of equations and become able to solve linear equations and use them to solve problems.

lessons.title: Equations and Their Solutions
lessons.summary: Equations, solutions, and the meaning of solving.

lessons.title: Properties of Equations
lessons.summary: How to solve equations using the four properties of equality.

lessons.title: Solving Equations Using Transposition
lessons.summary: Transposition and the steps for solving a linear equation.

lessons.title: Various Kinds of Equations
lessons.summary: Equations containing parentheses, decimals, and fractions.

lessons.title: Proportions (Ratio Equations)
lessons.summary: The value of a ratio and the properties of proportions.

lessons.title: Using Equations to Solve Problems
lessons.summary: The steps for solving word problems with equations and checking solutions.

units.title: Direct and Inverse Proportion
units.summary: You will become able to express the relationship between two quantities that change together using expressions, tables, and graphs.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.summary: The meaning of a function, variables, and domain.

lessons.title: Proportional Relationships and Their Equations
lessons.summary: The definition of direct proportion, the constant of proportionality, and direct proportion involving negative numbers.

lessons.title: Coordinates
lessons.summary: Coordinate axes, the origin, and the coordinates of a point.

lessons.title: Graphs of Proportions
lessons.summary: The features of graphs of direct proportion and how to draw them.

lessons.title: Inverse Proportion Equations
lessons.summary: The definition of inverse proportion and the constant of proportionality.

lessons.title: Graphs of Inverse Proportion
lessons.summary: The features of hyperbolas and how to draw them.

lessons.title: Applications of Proportion and Inverse Proportion
lessons.summary: Thinking about everyday phenomena as direct or inverse proportions.

units.title: Plane Figures
units.summary: Through transformations and constructions of figures, you will become able to investigate the properties of plane figures with foresight.

lessons.title: Lines and Angles
lessons.summary: Lines, line segments, rays, angles, perpendicular and parallel lines, and distance.

lessons.title: Moving Figures
lessons.summary: Translation, rotation, and reflection.

lessons.title: Basic Constructions
lessons.summary: Constructing perpendicular bisectors, angle bisectors, and perpendicular lines.

lessons.title: Circles and Sectors
lessons.summary: Arcs and chords, tangent lines, and the arc length and area of a sector.

units.title: Solid Figures
units.summary: You will observe solids and become able to investigate positional relationships in space, as well as surface areas and volumes.

lessons.title: Various Solids
lessons.summary: Prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones, and polyhedra.

lessons.title: Positions of Lines and Planes
lessons.summary: Parallel and perpendicular lines and planes in space, and skew lines.

lessons.title: Different Ways of Looking at Solids
lessons.summary: Solids made by moving faces or lines, nets, and projections.

lessons.title: Surface Area and Volume of Solids
lessons.summary: The surface area and volume of prisms and cylinders, pyramids and cones, and spheres.

units.title: Using Data
units.summary: You will become able to organize data, read trends, and express how likely events are to occur with numbers.

lessons.title: Frequency Distribution Tables and Histograms
lessons.summary: Classes, frequency, histograms, and frequency polygons.

lessons.title: Relative Frequency and Cumulative Frequency
lessons.summary: Relative frequency, cumulative frequency, and cumulative relative frequency.

lessons.title: Representative Values and Range
lessons.summary: Mean, median, and mode, range, and reading trends in data.

lessons.title: How Likely Is It to Happen?
lessons.summary: Many trials and relative frequency, and the idea of probability.
